verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a first-party open-source tool that takes a JSON or CSV list of users and bulk-creates them through the Backend API while respecting rate limits. This is a real bulk operation, but it is framed narrowly as migration tooling and covers only user creation. Nothing in the evidence shows bulk operations through the MCP server, the CLI, or the dashboard. missing for 10: bulk update/delete/ban of users, bulk organization or membership operations, bulk actions exposed via MCP/CLI for AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
